# @tansy/ai

An AI assistant for tansy on the Vercel AI SDK: chat that can create and edit content, filling forms, and writing fields, with any model provider. Add a provider package, such as @tansy/ai-openai.

```bash
npm install @tansy/ai
```

Add it to `tansy.config.ts`. See [the ai plugin documentation](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy/blob/main/docs/plugins/ai.md) for what it adds and the options it takes.

A first-party plugin for [tansy](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy), a self-hosted, runtime-schema CMS for Next.js. MIT licensed.
